description: The file 'read_article_screen.dart' contains a Flutter widget for displaying and interacting with a news article. It includes functionality for displaying web content, text-to-speech playback, sharing, saving, and browsing links. It also manages user controls for speech rate and voice selection.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple data class that holds the NewsArticle to be read in the screen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a web view of the news article and provides controls for text-to-speech, sharing, saving, and browsing.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the webview, text-to-speech settings, and user interactions within ReadArticleScreen.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A widget providing a popup menu for controlling speech playback (play, stop, speed, voice).

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Initializes and configures the FlutterTts engine settings.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles actions for browsing, sharing, and saving articles.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text content to be read aloud, appending a message about the paid version.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Triggers text-to-speech playback of the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Sets speech rate and plays the content.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the desired voice and plays the content.
